name: Compare answers, speed and cost of Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek and Qwen side by side with apimodels.app

parameters.content:
## Compare chat models side by side: answers, speed and cost

Pick a few models, type one prompt, and get every answer on one page with how long each took, how many tokens it used and what it actually cost. Useful when choosing a model for a feature, checking a prompt across vendors, or showing a team why one model is worth the price. All models run through one OpenAI-compatible key on [apimodels.app](https://apimodels.app).

### How it works
1. The form takes a prompt, an optional system message, 2 to 6 models and an output limit.
2. **One item per model** builds one request per selected model.
3. **Ask each model** sends them all at once to the chat completions endpoint.
4. **Get billing record** looks up each request by its id: the exact amount charged, token counts, and start and finish times measured on the server.
5. The result page shows a comparison table and every full answer, and marks the fastest and the lowest-cost model.

### Setup
1. Create an API key in the [apimodels console](https://apimodels.app/console/api-keys). New accounts get $0.1 of free credit.
2. Create a **Bearer Auth** credential with that key and select it in the two HTTP Request nodes.
3. Activate the workflow and open the production form URL from the trigger node.

### Customize
- Add any model id from `GET /v1/models` to the list in **One item per model** and to the form options.
- Reasoning models spend part of the output limit on thinking; raise the limit if answers stop early.

## 1. Ask every model
One request per selected model, all sent at the same time.

## 2. Measure and compare
Billing records give the real cost and server-side timing; the page puts it all in one table.
